limitations: This qualifies containers derived from the Dory GPU image/runtime contents; it does not inject Dory Mesa into arbitrary third-party images.
The engine readiness path still uses VK_DRIVER_FILES internally to pin the boot-time probe to the tuple-bound ICD; the container proof does not require Vulkan environment variables.

physicalNoEnvComputeProof.command: docker run --gpus all <computeImage> /bin/sh -lc env -u VK_DRIVER_FILES -u VK_ICD_FILENAMES -u LD_LIBRARY_PATH /compute /compute.spv
physicalNoEnvComputeProof.diagnosticNote: A first import attempt failed because macOS tar emitted AppleDouble ._ files; rerun used COPYFILE_DISABLE=1 and tar --no-xattrs so the Docker rootfs matched the ext4 contents.

scope: Dory-supported ARM64 GPU image activates tuple-bound Venus ICD through the standard Vulkan loader path; arbitrary images are not modified or host-library-mounted.
